d: Launched in Bahrain in November of 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We’re a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

To portion meals for our customers using our technology - ensuring all meals are ready and packaged to be dispatched on time for the deliveries, while adhering to high standards of hygiene, quality & consistency.
q: Must have at least 1-2 years of dispatching experience in the food industry, preferably in fast food
Holds very high standards in hygiene practices in a kitchen facility
Must be a proficient communicator in English
Knowledge in food safety is a plus
Enthusiastic and values respect for everyone around them
r: Portioning the components for every meal for every specific customer on time before deliveries go out
Communicating with the drivers & Customer Experience team to ensure a top notch customer experience
Maintaining proper hygiene standards in the kitchen
Ensuring any last minute changes are carried out with our high standards
100% of patients rounded on every two hours
100% of medications, including high-alert medications, administered per hospital policy
Rapid, protocol-driven response to life-threatening situations
Complete, accurate documentation from admission through discharge
Direct Patient Care: Assess, monitor, and prioritize patient needs, and deliver discharge instructions to patients and families.
Medication & Clinical Procedures: Administer medications, IV therapy, and blood transfusions safely, including high-alert medications.
Emergency Response: Respond swiftly to life-threatening situations in line with nursing standards and hospital protocols.
Unit Leadership: Serve as relief Charge Registered Nurse and teach fellow nurses core clinical skills.
Documentation & Quality: Maintain accurate documentation while upholding quality, safety, and regulatory standards.
Sound clinical judgment and anticipation of patient needs
Strong organization and time management in a fast-paced unit
Tactful, compassionate care across a multicultural setting
You will thrive here if you have
Bachelor's Degree in Nursing from an accredited Institute
3+ years of nursing experience after obtaining a Bachelor's degree
First Aid, CPR, ACLS, BLS, PALS, and NRP certifications, where applicable
Nursing competencies in at least 2 additional clinical areas
Proficiency in Electronic Medical Records and Microsoft Office
Fluency in English and a basic understanding of Taiba Hospital's nursing Arabic vocabulary
Communication – Clear, respectful interaction with patients, families, and teams
Customer Focus – Care that consistently exceeds patient expectations
Continuous Learning – Commitment to growth, training, and evidence-based practice
Values & Ethics – Honesty, integrity, and respect for every patient, colleague, and visitor
Adaptability – Flexibility to thrive amid unexpected change

d: We are seeking a Senior Microsoft Technical Consultant to join our Microsoft practice in Muscat. This is a client-facing role for someone who has spent several years in consulting and can operate credibly across the Microsoft ecosystem—from Dynamics 365 and business applications through the Azure stack, Microsoft 365, and Power Platform.

You will not be expected to be a deep-dive specialist in every product, but you must be technically credible in architecture discussions, workshops, and executive or technical meetings. You will support pre-sales, shape solutions, advise clients, and contribute to delivery as needed. Strong preference is given to Omani nationals.
q: Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, Dynamics-related, Power Platform, or security/identity) or willingness to pursue them.
Experience with solution selling, RFP responses, or technical pre-sales.
Exposure to security, identity (Entra ID), data/AI (Fabric, Copilot), or integration patterns.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
r: Pre-sales and RFP support: Collaborate with sales and account teams to shape technical responses, support demos, define solution approaches, and contribute to proposals and statements of work.

Solution architecture and design: Lead or co-lead high-level technical design of Microsoft solutions. Translate business requirements into credible architectures spanning Dynamics 365, Azure, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and related services. Produce clear diagrams, recommendations, and trade-off discussions.

Client workshops and advisory: Facilitate discovery workshops, present recommendations, and act as a trusted technical advisor in client meetings. Communicate complex topics clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

Hands-on contribution and delivery support: Contribute to configuration, solution design validation, or limited implementation work where it strengthens the engagement. Provide guidance to delivery teams and ensure solutions remain aligned with best practices.
Stay current with the Microsoft roadmap (including Copilot, Fabric, security/identity, and platform updates) and apply relevant capabilities to client scenarios.
Mentor junior consultants and contribute to internal knowledge sharing where appropriate.
5–8 years of experience in Microsoft consulting, technical advisory, or related delivery roles (Microsoft Partner / SI environment preferred).

Broad, credible knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, including Dynamics 365 (any major modules), Azure services and architecture concepts, Microsoft 365, and Power Platform. Depth is not required in every area, but you must be able to discuss architecture and trade-offs confidently.
Proven ability to operate effectively in client meetings, workshops, and pre-sales situations.
Fluent in both Arabic and English (spoken and written).
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work hybrid or on-site in Muscat, with occasional client travel within Oman or the region.
